text:
miguel: Heads-up — working on migrating a couple of nodegroups from Cluster Autoscaler -> Karpenter for bursty jobs (batch + ad-hoc). I have a TF plan to add IRSA + iam role for karpenter and a sealed secret for a metrics exporter. Quick Qs before I open the PR:

tara: +1, can you paste the TF snippet for the iam role? make sure we use EKS OIDC IRSA, not a static secret.

ash: FYI VPA + HPA can conflict. If pods are scaled by HPA set VPA to 'off' or recommendation-only. What HPA metrics are you using?

miguel: HPA uses a custom metric from prometheus-adapter: queue_length_per_pod. Also we have a sidecar pushing some metrics to CloudWatch for node-level signals.

kevin: sample TF we use for IRSA (simplified):
```
resource 'aws_iam_role' 'karpenter_sa' {
  name = 'redwood-karpenter-iam'
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.karpenter_assume.json
}
# create iam role and attach policies, then create k8s service account with eks_irsa module
```

miguel: here's the k8s ServiceAccount we plan to create (namespace karpenter):
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: karpenter
  namespace: karpenter
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-karpenter-iam
```

tara: Do NOT store AWS creds in plain k8s secrets. If you need to mount a token for the exporter use IRSA as well or sealed-secrets with KMS. Another option: init container fetches from SSM/ParameterStore at boot.

sre-qa: Quick note on HPA -> custom-metrics: prometheus-adapter needs RBAC and the metric name must match the adapter rules. If you switch node provisioning keep an eye on provisioning lag — Karpenter needs sensible ttlSecondsUntilExpired and consolidation settings to avoid thrash.

ash: Also, for any Deployment managed by HPA, prefer VPA in 'recommendation' mode or disabled for that object. Example annotation pattern (conceptual):
```
metadata:
  annotations:
    vpa.k8s.io/mode: 'recommendation'
```
We'll enforce this in the rollout checklist.

infra-bot: PR checker scanned repo — found missing OIDC provider lookup in TF and flagged a plain-secret usage in namespace monitoring. Link: https://git.internal/pr/12345 :eyes: 

kevin: For Karpenter Provisioner, staging snippet we use: 
```
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1alpha5
kind: Provisioner
spec:
  provider:
    subnetSelector:
      karpenter.sh/discovery: 'cluster-1'
  ttlSecondsUntilExpired: 300
  consolidation:
    enabled: true
```
Also consider node-ttl and limits for spot vs on-demand.

miguel: Thanks all. Action items: I'll prepare TF PR with eks_irsa module, add sealed-secrets for the exporter (or IRSA if possible), set VPA to recommendation-only for HPA'd workloads, and attach SRE to watch the first rollout. Will ping when PR is up.

tara: Sounds good — ping me for review. :thumbsup:

kevin: I can help validate provisioner config on staging.

sre-qa: I'll add an alert for node-provision-lag and HPA thrash and monitor the first 2 hours after rollout.

miguel: cool, closing for now — will post PR link. :rocket:
